definition: Two long bones shown crossed over each other, often beneath a skull.
author: Mark Twain
quote: Next night we stuck a picture, which Tom drawed in blood, of a skull and crossbones on the front door; and next night another one of a coffin on the back door.
example_sentence: The bottle was marked with a skull and crossbones.
